rules: BANNED LIST: Do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato for Headings.
Variable Fonts: Use font-light for elegance or font-black for impact. Avoid defaulting to generic Bold.
Headlines (Size > 32px): MUST use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines / Labels: MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line Height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Hierarchy Gap Rule: The jump between a heading and its subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4 (Swiss & High Contrast) mixed with ARCHETYPE 7 (Electric & Neon)
colors.vibe: Command-center focus, objective, rigid, functional. High-visibility 'Tactical' look.
rules: The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint neutral greys with a tiny bit of Blue (cool).
Contrast Check: Ensure text meets APCA standards.
ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Hover state color must be a lighter hue of ACTIVE state color.
Focus States: Must have HIGHER contrast than default state.
ONLY use primary / brand color for CTAs like button, form, etc. LIMIT the use of PRIMARY color.
FORBIDDEN_COLOR: teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4).
Expose the skeleton. Make the grid visible.
Container: use border-collapse style layout if applicable.
Items: border-r border-b border-border/40 (subtle borders on right and bottom of every grid item).
Visual Interest: Remove the border on the last item of a row to create an 'open' edge.
Dashboard Cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color darkens/glows slightly.
NO glassmorphism for data-heavy sections (prevents visual refraction of data).
textures_and_effects: Use crisp edges via semi-transparent borders + shadows.
Retro-Futurism/Terminal elements ONLY for the Simulator/Terminal components (e.g., green/cyan monospace text on pure black for logs).

component_rules.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none), high contrast text. Hover must be clearly defined.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn components. No native inputs. Strip the 'Vercel-look' (remove rounded corners, use stark 1px borders).
component_rules.charts: Use Shadcn charts / Recharts. MUST be accessible (color-blind-friendly palettes).
component_rules.tables: Dense, crisp lines, left-aligned data. Use Phosphor Icons for actions.
component_rules.navigation: Header must have a background (solid or crystal glass). Fixed headers must have z-50 and not overlap content.

grids_layouts.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics)
rules: Goal: Density, Data Correlation, Scanability.
Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column.
Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
Widget Ratios: Summary (col-span-1), Primary Data (col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3), Feed/List (col-span-1 row-span-2).
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch to match neighbors. No jagged bottoms.
Mobile-First: Always start with grid-cols-1.
spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy for sections (p-8 to p-12).
Containers with border MUST have padding on text content to avoid collision.

rules: Hover states (all interactive elements).
Click/press states.
Focus states (accessibility).
Entrance animations (staggered for lists) using Framer Motion.
Transition effects (smooth state changes).
NEVER apply universal transition (transition: all). Always target specific properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
Normal Text (below 18px): Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Large Text (18px+): Minimum 3:1 contrast ratio.
MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations/icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

icons.usage: Use for dense dashboards and developer tools (Duotone or Regular weight).

login_background.description: Abstract blue network lines and dots. Good for Login or Hero background overlay.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for standard SOC metrics (anomalies, event counts). If visualizing geographic threat origins, use react-globe.gl. If not, stick to crisp 2D Recharts for maximum clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a polished SOC experience without sacrificing clarity or safety labeling.
Ensure the Agentic AI portion (Decision, Response) is visually distinct from the ML classifier (Anomaly Detection). Use distinct color coding (e.g., Cyan for ML, Yellow/Orange for Agent actions).
Preserve partial shell rendering when API is unavailable (e.g., Terminal UI for the simulator).
Synthetic demonstration data must be clearly labeled as 'SIMULATED' or 'SAFE MODE'.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; prefer solid surfaces for data-heavy dashboard views.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
